verdict.rationale: WezTerm exposes a documented Lua scripting API (e.g. `wezterm.on`) and a CLI, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for this product. The pack shows only static reference pages, though, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. Nothing in the evidence describes an interactive explorer or runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
